description: This PHP source file defines an abstract controller class 'AbstractInstallerRestController' for handling RESTful API requests within the OrangeHRM installer module. It provides a common execute method to process various HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE), handle JSON input, set response headers, and manage exceptions, but leaves the specific request handling methods to be implemented by subclasses.

classes.name: AbstractInstallerRestController
classes.description: An abstract controller class providing REST API handling logic and error management for installer functionalities.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Handles HTTP request, unserializes JSON content if present, dispatches to specific method handlers based on HTTP method, manages exceptions, and returns a response.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Stub method to handle GET requests, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Stub method to handle POST requests, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: handlePut
methods.description: Stub method to handle PUT requests, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Stub method to handle DELETE requests, to be implemented by subclasses.
